name: double-click-toggles-fullscreen
description: Double-clicking the picture toggles window mode - the gesture a viewer uses to go fullscreen.

steps.note: Double-click the actual Quick video item; PlayerWindow receives its fullscreen request.
Bounded settle between the two gestures; the assertions below carry the scenario.
The same gesture again, so the assertion can tell a toggle from a one-way set.
Bounded settle after the second gesture.

assertions.note: The real Quick video item is double-clicked; the PlayerWindow/controller reports the two fullscreen changes.

The window starts windowed, and two double-clicks must each toggle its actual mode back to windowed. This reads the final native window state rather than attaching an ignored expected count to a binary signal assertion.
